verdict.rationale: Unleash Edge is a documented lightweight caching/relay layer that can be deployed close to users (e.g., at CDN/edge) to evaluate flags with low latency, handle thousands of SDK connections without hitting the primary instance, and even keep PII local to the edge node for targeting. This directly satisfies edge/relay-layer flag evaluation. Missing for 10: no explicit CDN-worker (e.g., Cloudflare/Fastly Workers) native integration or deployment guide, and no independent/hands-on benchmark of edge latency performance.
